objects.name: Analytic 2239
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Open Platform Communications (OPC) Unified Architecture (UA) method invocations or International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) 61850 Abstract Common Services Interface (ACSI) service requests arriving at a field device from a client identity not in the approved application allowlist, where the invoked method is a write or control operation rather than read/subscribe. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
